article.title: 翻译 · 社会制度的教育作用与正式教育的形成
article.background: 教育哲学与社会制度。只保留46-50五个划线目标句，围绕社会制度的间接教育作用、对青少年的塑造以及正式学校教育的产生展开。语气理性、抽象、清晰。

sentences.en: It may be said that the measure of the worth of any social institution is its effect in enlarging and improving experience, but this effect is not a part of its original motive.
sentences.zh: 可以说，衡量任何社会制度价值的尺度，在于它能否扩大并改善人的经验；但这种作用并不是该制度最初形成时的动机之一。
prosody_focus: not a part of its original motive

segments.text: It may be said that the measure of the worth of any social institution is its effect in enlarging and improving experience, but this effect is not a part of its original motive.

sentences.en: Only gradually was the by-product of the institution noted, and only more gradually still was this effect considered as a directive factor in the conduct of the institution.
sentences.zh: 人们只是逐渐注意到这种制度所产生的副作用，而又过了更长时间，才把这种作用视为指导制度运行的一个因素。

segments.text: Only gradually was the by-product of the institution noted, and only more gradually still was this effect considered as a directive factor in the conduct of the institution.

sentences.en: While it is easy to ignore in our contact with them the effect of our acts upon their disposition, it is not so easy as in dealing with adults.
sentences.zh: 在同年轻人交往时，我们虽然也容易忽视自己的行为会对他们的性情产生什么影响，但要像对待成年人那样对此完全不加理会，却没有那么容易。

segments.text: While it is easy to ignore in our contact with them the effect of our acts upon their disposition, it is not so easy as in dealing with adults.

sentences.en: Since our chief business with them is to enable them to share in a common life we cannot help considering whether or not we are forming the powers which will secure this ability.
sentences.zh: 既然我们与年轻人相处时最主要的任务，是使他们能够参与共同生活，我们就不能不考虑：自己是否正在培养那些能够保证他们具备这种能力的素质。

segments.text: Since our chief business with them is to enable them to share in a common life we cannot help considering whether or not we are forming the powers which will secure this ability.

sentences.en: We are thus led to distinguish, within the broad educational process which we have been so far considering, a more formal kind of education—that of direct tuition or schooling.
sentences.zh: 因此，在我们迄今所讨论的广义教育过程中，我们进一步区分出一种更正式的教育形式，也就是直接教学或学校教育。

segments.text: We are thus led to distinguish, within the broad educational process which we have been so far considering, a more formal kind of education—that of direct tuition or schooling.
